create_word_dropout_noiser: create a WordDropout instance to randomly drop words from tokenized sentences with configurable dropout probability
create_word_shuffle_noiser: create a WordShuffle instance to shuffle words by no more than k positions in tokenized sentences
create_unsupervised_mt_noiser: create an UnsupervisedMTNoising instance that applies word shuffle, dropout, and blanking noise to source tokens
create_noising_dataset: create a NoisingDataset wrapper that applies noise to samples from a source dataset using a WordNoising instance
use_word_noising_base: use the WordNoising base class to get BPE word indices or token indices for noise-aware word grouping
